sources.title: Blood Cancer Detection with Explainable AI Using Deep Learning
sources.snippet: This study presents an explainable AIbased deep learning model for blood cancer detection that integrates convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for feature extraction, applies knowledge transfer to leverage prior learning, and combines these with Llama to enhance diagnostic transparency and support healthcare professionals.

sources.title: (PDF) Benchmarking large language models GPT-4o, llama 3.1, and qwen 2. ...
sources.snippet: This study evaluates GPT-4o, Llama 3.1, and Qwen 2.5 in classifying genetic variants from the OncoKB and CIViC databases, as well as a real-world dataset derived from FoundationOne CDx reports.
